subject: Kickoff: AssembleNet / AssembleNet++ for video understanding
body:
Hi Santiago, team,

Kicking off the AssembleNet work. Both AssembleNet and AssembleNet++ do neural connectivity search over multi-stream video CNN architectures — they learn the weights of connections between convolutional blocks built from (2+1)D or 3D residual modules, arranged sequentially or in parallel, so the architecture itself is optimized for the data and task. AssembleNet++ adds peer-attention on top.

The code builds three model types via assemblenet_mode: AssembleNet, AssembleNet++, and AssembleNet++Lite, the lighter variant made to fit GPU memory.

Product framing: our video content-understanding pipeline needs a stronger backbone; this gives us searched architectures rather than hand-tuned ones.

Milestones: TF1 environment and repro by early May, Lite variant benchmarking in late May, readout the week of June 29.

Lucia
